title: The Uplift: A nun, a Navy mom, a new grad
summary: Meet the nun who became a trailblazer for girls' sports; the Navy mom and her son who got the the car they dreamed of – and much more; and the 84-year-old graduate who fulfilled a bucket list item to get her college degree. All of that, plus our most heartwarming viral videos of the week, on "The Uplift."
